gloss: can hold; to have, possess (持てる力)

definitions.gloss: can hold; can carry; can have
definitions.explanation: The potential form of {持|も}つ used as a verb of its own: to be able to hold, carry or have something.

definitions.gloss: that one has; possessed (before a noun)
definitions.explanation: In written and formal style, {持|も}てる before a noun means "that one has": {持|も}てる{力|ちから} is all the strength one has.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{持|も}てる。
examples.english: I can carry this box by myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}くて→重い：00804_omoi⟧{持|も}てない。

examples.english: Ever since I was a child, it was my dream to have a room of my own.

examples.japanese: {持|も}てる⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し{切|き}る→出し切る：30155_dashikiru⟧。
examples.english: To give it everything one has.

examples.japanese: {持|も}てる⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{持|も}たざる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧。
⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{持|も}てる⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すべて⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}した→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧。
examples.english: In the final, the players showed every bit of strength they had.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧/⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}てる: can hold, can carry
- ⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}てる: can feel confident
- {持|も}てる⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し{切|き}る→出し切る：30155_dashikiru⟧ / ⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to give it one's all (sense 2)
- {持|も}てる⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: the haves (sense 2, written style)

WATCH OUT:
{持|も}てる (can hold) and モテる (to be popular with the other sex) share the reading. モテる is usually written in katakana; {持|も}てる with kanji is the potential of ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧.
